description: [$x402 pay-per-call] Scans TCP ports on a host (direct connect, 3s timeout per port, parallelized).

ports.description: Comma-separated list of ports (max 50). Defaults to common ports.

x_payment.description: Optional. Signed x402 payment header (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT) from the caller. If omitted, returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements.

name: net_tools_port_scan
